{1: 'The Lantern Chamber'}
{2: 'The Lantern Chamber'}
{3: 'You follow Nirvatia through the family mansion, winding deeper into the inner courtyard until you stop before a single door.'}
{3: 'The wooden door sits ajar. You do not have to push it open to see what is inside.'}

{3: 'Every wall and every inch of floor is covered in Rorschach inkblot drawings. Dark and light patches layered over one another, barely leaving room to walk. The whole space presses down depressingly.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Nirvatia steps sideways, placing herself between you and the room.'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "Don't look. Just walk straight through.", 4: '1'}

{3: 'You two pick your way through the paper-strewn floor toward the far end of the room. Nirvatia raises a hand and runs her fingers along the cold stone wall, tracing the gaps between bricks, then presses in sharply.'}
{3: 'Click—'}
{3: 'The grinding of old brass gears echoes through the sealed room as the thick stone wall retracts in layers, slowly revealing a passage leading underground.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1306.jpg'}
{3: 'At the end of the narrow passage, a soul lantern suddenly appears in your view past the last stone archway.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiMovie/FxUiMovieGlow.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'There is no flame inside the glass casing, only a strange hexahedron, with warm, golden light flowing endlessly from it.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiMovie/FxUiMovieGlow.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'This is the soul lantern of Velosenne. Without it, anyone who sets foot in the forbidden grounds will lose their way.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'Neither of us may fear the mist infection, but whatever lurks in the depths of the Mist will tear us apart.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "Let's take it, then.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The two of you approach the bronze pedestal holding the lantern, your steps slow and measured.'}
{3: 'The pedestal stands about waist-high, its face set with three dust-veiled gems.'}

{3: "Two handprint-shaped recesses are carved into the surface, each just large enough to fit an adult's palm. The rim of each slot is embedded with silver thorns, their fine tips darkened with rust."}
{3: 'Scattered beside the pedestal are old bones from different eras.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1306.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5', 7: '0|0|-100'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1306.jpg', 7: '0|0|-100'}
{2: 'What is this thing...', 3: '56'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'To claim the soul lantern and enter the forbidden grounds, two people must each stand with their palms in the recesses and ask each other three questions.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "Answer all three truthfully, and the seal will open. Breathe a single lie, and the thorns will tighten, and you'll never leave here alive.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'These... are what became of those who failed before us.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'All this just to grab a lantern?', 3: '62'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'Who knows what those old relics were thinking. Probably just paranoid about their heirs spilling family secrets to outsiders.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "Rules are rules, though. Without going through this, we don't get the lantern, and we don't get to set foot in the forbidden grounds.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'Every truth you seek about the Mist lies waiting in the depths of the forbidden grounds.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She looks up at you, her fingertips tapping lightly against the two recesses.'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "To thank you for coming this far with me, you get two questions, and I'll take the last one.", 4: '1'}

{3: "You stare at the ring of thorns for a moment, their cold gleam almost laughable. This feels like the noble's twisted version of Truth or Dare, but with bones carpeting the floor, there is nothing remotely funny about it."}
{3: 'Without a choice, you give a small nod and slowly slide a hand into the recess.'}
{1: '1', 3: "The curved groove locks snugly around your wrist. You look up to find Nirvatia standing face to face across from you with just half an arm's width of bronze in between."}
{3: 'You clear your throat and ask the first question.'}
{2: 'When did you get into my room?', 3: '83'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'I never set foot in your room. That was my magical pet Morigan, a raven born alongside my black scythe.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "He scouts ahead for me and carries my messages. But my power is too low to hold the scythe's blade for long, so he's gone quiet for now.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Ui/Prefab/UiEffect/UiMovie/FxUiMovie4DMainBgAurora.prefab', 2: '1', 5: '20'}
{3: 'The words barely leave her lips when a faint click sounds from within the bronze stand, and the lowest gem flickers to life with a dim, ghostly green glow.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Ui/Prefab/UiEffect/UiMovie/FxUiMovie4DMainBgAurora.prefab', 5: '20'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The recesses sink down a notch, and both of you are pulled forward before you can react. The distance between you is suddenly further cut in half.'}
{3: 'You avert her gaze uncomfortably and ask the second question.'}
{2: "What made you so sure I'd show up tonight?", 3: '103'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "I wasn't sure. If you hadn't come, I wouldn't have had this chance to change my fate.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'At least I could see my sisters one last time.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Ui/Prefab/UiEffect/UiMovie/FxUiMovie4DMainBgAurora.prefab', 2: '1', 5: '21'}
{3: 'A second click rings out, and the middle gem lights up with the same soft green glow.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Ui/Prefab/UiEffect/UiMovie/FxUiMovie4DMainBgAurora.prefab', 5: '21'}
{1: '1', 3: "The recesses sink again. This time, you are close enough that you can make out every individual lash above Nirvatia's eyes."}
{3: 'Her warm breath grazes your cheek, leaving a faint, tingling warmth in its wake.'}
{3: 'Catching you in a daze, Nirvatia cannot help the small smile that tugs at the corner of her eyes.'}
{3: 'Your ears burn. You lean back, putting some distance between you, and clear your throat with a pointed little cough.'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'Last question. My turn.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "When did you figure out that Bulgakov wasn't one of the good guys?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: 'I—or rather, my pet—never once saw you write that conclusion on your detective board.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "Just now? You sounded so sure back at Margaret's. I thought you'd already figured it all out.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'My suspicion technically started when you invited me here.', 3: '134'}
{2: 'You never acted like someone running from her crimes.', 3: '135'}
{2: "After the conversation just now, I'm certain that they don't hate you.", 3: '137'}
{2: 'Then the answer is obvious.', 3: '138'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Ui/Prefab/UiEffect/UiMovie/FxUiMovie4DMainBgAurora.prefab', 2: '1', 5: '22'}
{3: 'A third click sounds, and all three green gems light up.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Ui/Prefab/UiEffect/UiMovie/FxUiMovie4DMainBgAurora.prefab', 5: '22'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiMovie/FxUiMovieGlow.prefab', 2: '3', 5: '11'}

{3: 'The silver thorns coiled along the groove snap back into the cracks. The mechanism releases, and the soul lantern suspended in midair drifts gently down, settling at just the right height for either of you to reach.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiMovie/FxUiMovieGlow.prefab', 5: '11'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "Incredible deduction. I'm impressed.", 4: '1'}
{3: "She tilts her chin toward the lantern that is now within her arm's reach."}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "All three questions answered truthfully, meaning we've earned enough trust to rely on each other. Now, let's take down this soul lantern together.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Both of you reach up at the same time, your fingertips brushing the cold metal frame of the lantern.'}

{1: '1', 3: 'Right then, your hand is caught on the groove, and you let out a muffled grunt. Your brow furrowed, you hiss through gritted teeth while cold sweat beads at your temples, and your voice cracks under the strain.'}
{2: "Something's off.", 3: '166'}
{2: "Is there something you're still hiding from me?", 3: '167'}
{3: "Nirvatia's face drains of color instantly. Without a moment's hesitation, she lunges forward to grab your hand."}
{2: 'Nirvatia', 3: "That's impossible, I didn't—", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The moment her fingertips graze your wrist, she spots the telltale tremor in your shoulders. You are barely holding back laughter.'}
{3: 'You slowly withdraw your perfectly unscathed hand and give your wrist a casual little roll, your eyes glinting with mischief.'}
{2: 'You tested me at the ball. Consider this me returning the favor.', 3: '179'}
{2: "We're about to head into danger. I need to know you're trustworthy.", 3: '180'}
{2: 'You passed the test.', 3: '181'}
{3: 'Furious and exasperated, Nirvatia shoots you a withering glare, then snatches the hovering soul lantern out of the air.'}
